method: No-vig sportsbook anchor, then RESEARCH.md stats (moves capped at 4 points). Polymarket prices from polymarket.com/sports/cfb/games, /sports/nba/games and /sports/nfl page snapshots (~15:00Z Oct 24). The gamma API and direct polymarket.com URLs were not approved for this run except pages surfaced by search, so asks are page prices (not verified order-book asks), bids are 1 - the other side's price, and liquidity is unknown (null). Slugs from search results are verified (nfl-gb-det-2026-10-25, nfl-pit-no-2026-10-25, nfl-la-lv-2026-10-25); others follow the usual pattern and are NOT verified.

legs.label: CFB: Florida Atlantic -8.5 vs Rice
legs.why: Anchor: books moved FAU from -9.5 open to -9.5/-10.5 (Covers: 9.5 with -105 to -118 juice; Betr FAU -9.5 -115 = 50.5% no-vig; Dimers book FAU -10.5 +125, Novig FAU -10.5 44.3%). So P(FAU by 10+) ~50%, and -8.5 also wins on a 9-point margin (~2.5% in CFB): ~52.5%. ML check: FAU -340 to -400 (Covers), Betr -385/+271 = 74.7%, Polymarket ML 75c: consistent, so the Polymarket spread line is the outlier (half a key-ish point stale). Stats: Rice QB Jacurri Brown (ankle) doubtful, Gael Ochoa starts; Rice WR Ben Grice and TE Will Swartz out; FAU RB Ervin, TE Johnson, WR Valsin questionable (Rotowire). The QB news is the reason for the line move, so it is priced: no move from the anchor. Dimers model projects 30-31 to 23 (~7.5) which leans the other way: weak evidence, not used. Total 52.5-55. Records, EPA: n/a (not found within budget). Home field FAU. Edge +3.5c on the page price; verify the live ask on the Mac before kickoff (16:00Z).

legs.label: NFL: Packers +3.5 at Lions
legs.why: Anchor: Caesars GB +3.5 (-117), BetMGM DET -3.5 (-105) => GB +3.5 ~52% no-vig; ML DET -175 / GB +157 (62.4% DET), consensus DET -180/+150; spread opened/held DET -3. Stats: GB 4-2, won 3 straight (23-13 vs DAL); Love 5th in pass yds/game with 24 completions of 20+ yds vs a DET defense that is last in total defense and allows the most EPA/play on 20+ air-yard throws. DET 3-2, off a bye, ~33 ppg (2nd), Goff 12 TD/0 INT, Hutchinson 32 pressures in 5 games. GB 4-1 ATS last 5 meetings (weak). Injuries: GB LB Zaire Franklin OUT, G Aaron Banks Q, CB St-Juste Q, Jacobs back from exempt list; DET S Brian Branch Q (Achilles), C Cade Mays Q. Indoors (Ford Field), weather n/a. Rest: DET off bye (edge DET). Matchup lean GB offsets the bye; no move. 52% vs ask 51c: +1c, below bar.

legs.label: NFL: Ravens to beat Bengals
legs.why: Anchor: consensus CIN -118 / BAL -102 => BAL 48.3%. Opened BAL -3 (-160); flipped to CIN -1.5 on Wednesday's Lamar Jackson news. Lamar (high-ankle sprain Oct 4, missed 2 games) limited all week, QUESTIONABLE, 'trending in the right direction', late decision possible; Huntley starts otherwise (3rd straight; BAL 3-1 in his starts since 2025, 7-12 all-time without Lamar). Henry leads NFL (130 car, 534 yds, 7 TD); CIN off bye but allowed a season-high 217 rush yds at MIA. Burrow 289.5 yds/g in 11 starts vs BAL; BAL 11-3 vs CIN with Lamar. BAL OUT OLB Robinson, S Hawkins; CB Tampa doubtful; CIN no designations. BAL just lost at CLE. Weather n/a. Market prices roughly a 1-in-3 chance Lamar plays; +0.5c. Lean only: if Lamar is declared active, BAL should be ~58% and this becomes value (check the inactives ~15:30Z Sunday).

legs.label: NFL: Falcons to beat 49ers
legs.why: Anchor: 8-book consensus SF -148 / ATL +124 => ATL 42.8%; spread -2.5 (-115) everywhere but HardRock -3; total 49.5. Moved from SF -4.5 / -218 open on SF injuries: OUT WR Mike Evans, WR Deebo Samuel, DE Nick Bosa, LBs Gifford and Wallow, S Sigle; WR Kirk and CB Stout Q. ATL OUT RB Brian Robinson, OT Jerrell, LB Deablo; Q both Terrell CBs, Henderson, Ebukam, Za'Darius Smith, Dexter. Injury news is days old and the line moved 2 points: priced. Indoors. 43% vs ask 43c: no edge.

legs.label: NFL (Paris): Saints to beat Steelers
legs.why: Anchor: consensus PIT -162 / NO +136 => NO 40.7%; opened PIT -2 (-130/+110), now -3 (DK -3.5). Neutral site (Paris), so NO's nominal home field is worth little; travel equal. PIT OUT WR Skowronek, CB Echols; RB Dowdle Q (limited all week). NO G Cesar Ruiz Q, DT Shepherd Q (illness). Total 44.5. EPA/last-5: n/a within budget. 41% vs 40c: +1c, below bar.

legs.label: NFL: Buccaneers to beat Panthers
legs.why: Anchor: consensus CAR -155 / TB +130 => TB 41.7% (open CAR -175/+145); DK CAR -3.5. Mayfield (dislocated right thumb, Week 3) QUESTIONABLE after returning to practice; rookie Jalon Daniels started the last 3 (TB 1-2 without Mayfield, close games). TB 1-5. TB OUT WR Egbuka, RT Goedeke, S Winfield. CAR OUT OLBs Jaelan Phillips and Incoom; Bryce Young full. Total 44.5. Mayfield playing is partly priced (line came back from -175). 42% vs 42c: no edge; lean TB only if Mayfield is active.

legs.label: NFL: Browns to win at Titans
legs.why: Anchor: consensus CLE -130 / TEN +110 => CLE 54.3%; line flipped from TEN -2.5 open to CLE -2.5. CLE OUT QB Dillon Gabriel (back), G Teven Jenkins, DTs Khalil Davis and Mike Hall; CB Denzel Ward and S Delpit Q. TEN no OUTs; WR Calvin Ridley Q (no practice last 2 days), RB Spears Q. Total 36.5 (lowest on the board). Starter for CLE and EPA: n/a within budget. 54% vs 55c: -1c.

legs.label: NFL: Broncos-Cardinals Over 42.5
legs.why: Anchor: consensus total 43.5 (O -112 / U -108), open 43.5 => Over 42.5 ~52.5% (43 carries a little weight). ML DEN -230 / ARI +190. ARI QB Carson Beck Q (back), RB Jeremiyah Love OUT, OL Gaines OUT, CB Melton Q, S Budda Baker Q; DEN RB Badie OUT, RB Coleman Q, CB Surtain Q (limited), S Hufanga OUT. Defensive absences on both sides vs a possible backup QB for ARI roughly cancel. Retractable roof: weather n/a. +0.5c.
